section_heading: 2.2 CLEWISE model architecture and sector modules
first_eight_words: CLEWISE is implemented as a linear, least-cost optimization
statement_as_written: CLEWISE is implemented as a linear, least-cost optimization model using the open-source OSeMOSYS formulation. The model minimizes the discounted sum of investment, operation and maintenance, and fuel costs subject to constraints on: energy balance (supply, transformation and demand); capacity expansion and retirement; resource availability (hydrology, biomass, fossil fuels); and policy targets (e.g., renewable shares, emission caps, technology bans).
